envelope.description: Opt-in deadline on the shared rpc

body.title: Opt-in deadline on the shared rpc
body.summary: Add the optional fourth parameter { timeoutMs } to rpc in src/shared/ipc-client.ts: with it the request rejects on the deadline and on the socket ending or closing before a reply, always destroys the socket and clears the timer; without it nothing changes. src/cli/client.ts keeps re-exporting it.
acceptanceChecks: Existing ipc-client tests pass unchanged and rpc without opts behaves as before
A silent fake socket rejects with a timeout error and a socket that ends or closes before a reply rejects with a closed error
The socket is destroyed and the timer cleared on every outcome, and a reply inside the deadline resolves normally

tests.name: src/shared/__tests__/ipc-client-timeout.test.ts: rpc without opts is unchanged for a reply, an error and a split reply
src/shared/__tests__/ipc-client-timeout.test.ts: rpc with timeoutMs rejects on silence and on early close and cleans up
